verification_method: Original full-text tables/results via Europe PMC XML for Peters and Hashimoto; original full text via NCBI BioC plus Europe PMC metadata for Liu. Gene-specific evidence and measurement scope recorded below.

references.authors: Peters MJ, Joehanes R, Pilling LC, et al.
references.title: The transcriptional landscape of age in human peripheral blood.
references.supports_zh: Table 1 lists LRRN3 as age-associated with negative discovery, replication and meta-analysis Z-scores. This supplies blood-transcriptome age-association context for the negative CD4 model direction.
references.measurement_scope_zh: 人类全血转录组多队列分析；本项目测量为CD4谱系聚合RNA。文献提供表达方向背景，未检验本次模型性能或CD4内干预机制。

references.authors: Liu Y, Chen Y, Richardson B.
references.title: Decreased DNA methyltransferase levels contribute to abnormal gene expression in 'senescent' CD4(+)CD28(-) T cells.
references.checked_scope: Original Results and Figure 1C; cohort recruitment and assay sample descriptions
references.evidence_quote: We found that the CD70, perforin and KIR2DL4 promoters are demethylated in CD4(+)CD28(-) T cells relative to CD4(+)CD28(+) T cells.
references.supports_zh: CD70异常表达与人类CD4+CD28−分化状态及表观调控有关，为模型CD70正方向提供共刺激与分化状态背景。
references.measurement_scope_zh: 特定CD4+CD28−亚群的表达和甲基化研究，招募包含类风湿关节炎与老年非RA供者，RNA比较为5名供者。该证据用于分化状态背景，不将小样本亚群比较直接外推为普通成人CD4随年龄单调变化。

references.authors: Hashimoto K, Kouno T, Ikawa T, et al.
references.title: Single-cell transcriptomics reveals expansion of cytotoxic CD4 T cells in supercentenarians.
references.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the USA
references.checked_scope: Original Results on cytotoxic CD4 cluster, Figure 4 and Figure 6E; adult-reference comparison
references.evidence_quote: One of the clusters comprised CD4 CTLs, characterized by the coexpression of GZMH, GZMA, GZMB, NKG7, and PRF1 as well as low expression of SELL, CD27, and CCR7.
references.supports_zh: GZMB参与人类细胞毒性CD4 T细胞的表达程序，支持将模型正方向解释为细胞毒性及效应分化线索。
references.measurement_scope_zh: 核心比较涉及超百岁人与50至80多岁对照。成人参考数据中CD4 CTL比例未显示显著年龄组差异，故该文用于细胞状态解释，不证明普通成人GZMB随年龄单调上升，也不解释本项目CD4性能优势的原因。
